chunks: O Allah, preserve my face (dignity) with ease (of livelihood)
and do not disgrace my status with poverty (destitution)
lest I beg for sustenance from those who seek Your sustenance
and seek the favour of the evil of Your creatures
and be tested by praising those who give to me
and be tempted by abusing those who withhold from me
and You are, beyond all that, the Bestower and the Withholder
Verily, You are All-Powerful over all things.
ai.seo_question: How does one maintain dignity and avoid spiritual testing through wealth or poverty?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (AS) articulates a profound psychological insight where material sufficiency safeguards spiritual integrity, preventing the degradation of dignity through dependency on others' whims. This supplication underscores the Shia concept of 'Izzah' (honor) derived from self-sufficiency, framing wealth not as an end but as a means to avoid the spiritual trials of arrogance in the giver and bitterness in the receiver. It reflects the broader theological principle that while humans experience the mechanisms of provision, the ultimate authority over giving and withholding rests solely with Allah.
